rationale: Engine records can name the ultrafast processing preference. Claudexor.app 6.0.0-6.1.2 decodes ReviewerPanelEntry.processingPreference strictly and cannot read a run whose reviewer panel names it; Claudexor.app 6.2.0 can decode this value. The local updater leaves the current engine in place when it reports appUpdateRequired. The SSH manifest separately uses the release version as its app floor; its compatibility check prevents an older app from connecting to the host until the application is updated. This floor applies to Claudexor.app, not to embedding-host compatibility.
